Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma,J.

The present Application has been filed by the applicant-Parikshit Parse seeking anticipatory bail in
Case Crime No.57 of 2024, registered at Kotwali Pauri, District Pauri Garhwal under Sections 420 &
120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 3 of the Uttarakhand Protection of Interest of
Depositors (In Financial Establishments) Act, 2005.

sentences.text: 2. Heard Mr. S.R.S. Gill, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. Pradeep Lohani, learned Brief Holder for the respondent.
3. Mr. S.R.S. Gill, Advocate, contended that according to the present case, the informant and other depositors deposited their money with the Society, namely, LUCC Society.
Their money have not been returned by the Society.

He further submitted that the present applicant, aged about 53 years,
is not named in the First Information Report.

He was only service provider to the said Society,
namely, LUCC Society.
He has been falsely implicated in the present matter.
He is a permanent resident of District Indore (Madhya Pradesh), therefore, there is no possibility of his absconding.
4. Mr. Pradeep Lohani, Brief Holder has sought three weeks' time to file objection to the anticipatory bail application.
5. Time is granted.

sentences.text:
6. Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case, as an ad-interim measure, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicant-Parikshit Parse, he shall be released on interim bail on executing a personal bond of Rs.30,000/- and two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Officer,
subject to the following conditions:-
(i) Applicant shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency and he shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) Applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case.
(iii) Applicant shall not leave the country without the previous permission of this Court.

7. List on 27.06.2025 for hearing on the Anticipatory Bail Application.
___________________ ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
